symbols.name: complex vector
symbols.meaning: A complex vector of length q, whose vector norm is its largest coordinate modulus.
symbols.quote: Here $w$ denotes a complex vector of length $q$.

symbols.name: linear map
symbols.meaning: A linear map from complex vectors to complex vectors, whose operator norm is taken.
symbols.quote: Here $L$ denotes a linear map from complex vectors to complex vectors.

symbols.name: second linear map
symbols.meaning: Another linear map, composed with L in the product LM.
symbols.quote: For another linear map $M$, the composition $LM$ applies $M$ first and then $L$.

symbols.name: scaled Gaussian map
symbols.meaning: Half of a Gaussian resampling map, used as the map A.
symbols.quote: Here $S'$ denotes half of a [Gaussian resampling](gaussian-resampling.md) map.

symbols.name: scaled inverse map
symbols.meaning: Half the inverse of an invertible map close to the identity.
symbols.quote: Here $J'$ denotes half the inverse of an invertible map close to the identity.

symbols.name: scaled diagonal map
symbols.meaning: A diagonal map scaled by a fixed factor at most one.
symbols.quote: Here $D'$ denotes a diagonal map scaled by a fixed factor at most one.

symbols.name: coordinate selection
symbols.meaning: A map that selects some coordinates of its input vector, so that each output entry copies one input entry.
symbols.quote: Here $C$ denotes a map that selects some coordinates, so each output entry copies one input entry and $\|C\|\le 1$.
